panels.title: Data status

targets.rawSql:
select 'auctions' as "table", min("date") as first, max("date") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("date")) as age, approximate_row_count('"jao"."auctions"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "jao"."auctions"
union all
select 'auction_results' as "table", min("date") as first, max("date") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("date")) as age, approximate_row_count('"jao"."auction_results"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "jao"."auction_results"
union all
select 'bids_daily' as "table", min("date") as first, max("date") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("date")) as age, approximate_row_count('"jao"."bids_daily"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "jao"."bids_daily"
union all
select 'bids_weekly' as "table", min("date") as first, max("date") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("date")) as age, approximate_row_count('"jao"."bids_weekly"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "jao"."bids_weekly"
union all
select 'bids_monthly' as "table", min("date") as first, max("date") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("date")) as age, approximate_row_count('"jao"."bids_monthly"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "jao"."bids_monthly"
union all
select 'bids_quarterly' as "table", min("date") as first, max("date") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("date")) as age, approximate_row_count('"jao"."bids_quarterly"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "jao"."bids_quarterly"
union all
select 'bids_seasonal' as "table", min("date") as first, max("date") as latest, extract(epoch from now() - max("date")) as age, approximate_row_count('"jao"."bids_seasonal"'::regclass) as "rows (approx)" from "jao"."bids_seasonal"

panels.description: First and latest timestamp per table, age of the latest value (green < 48 h, orange < 168 h, red older) and approximate row count (TimescaleDB approximate_row_count).

options.content:
**JAO** (Joint Allocation Office, crawler `jao`, schema `jao`): explicit capacity auctions on borders that are *not* in flow-based market coupling
(mainly Switzerland, Great Britain interconnectors, Balkan, Ukraine borders; Germany only borders CH via explicit auctions). Prices are **EUR/MW** per product hour (about EUR/MWh of capacity), capacity in MW.

* `date` is the start of the delivery period (local midnight, stored as UTC), `corridorCode` is the direction `FROM-TO`.
* Daily auction results have one product per hour (`B01` = 00-01 h); long-term products (weekly ... yearly) are `BASE` or `PEAK` for the whole period.
* `bids_*` contain every submitted bid (bids_daily has > 150 M rows, so dashboard queries always filter by time and corridor).
* Day-ahead auctions on a DST change day have 23 or 25 products; the hour-based time axis is approximate on these days.

panels.title: Average auction price

targets.rawSql: select avg("auctionPrice") as v from jao.auction_results where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode"='$corridor' and "productIdentification" ~ '^B[0-9]{2}-'

panels.description: Mean daily-auction price on the selected corridor.

panels.title: Average offered capacity

targets.rawSql: select avg("offeredCapacity") as v from jao.auction_results where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode"='$corridor' and "productIdentification" ~ '^B[0-9]{2}-'

panels.description: Mean capacity offered per hour in the daily auction.

panels.title: Capacity allocated

targets.rawSql: select 100*sum("allocatedCapacity")/nullif(sum("offeredCapacity"),0) as v from jao.auction_results where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode"='$corridor' and "productIdentification" ~ '^B[0-9]{2}-'

panels.description: Allocated capacity as share of the offered capacity.

panels.title: Oversubscription

targets.rawSql: select sum("requestedCapacity")/nullif(sum("offeredCapacity"),0) as v from jao.auction_results where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode"='$corridor' and "productIdentification" ~ '^B[0-9]{2}-'

panels.description: Requested capacity divided by offered capacity. Values above 1 mean the auction was congested.

panels.title: Cancelled auctions

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as v from jao.auctions where $__timeFilter(date) and cancelled

panels.description: Number of cancelled auctions (all horizons and corridors) with delivery in the range.

panels.title: Corridors with daily auction

targets.rawSql: select count(distinct "corridorCode") as v from jao.auction_results where $__timeFilter(date)

panels.description: Number of corridor directions with results in the range.

panels.title: Auction price and day-ahead spread: $corridor

targets.rawSql:
with z as (select case split_part('$corridor','-',1) when 'DE' then 'DE_LU' when 'IT' then 'IT_NORD' else split_part('$corridor','-',1) end as f,
 case split_part('$corridor','-',2) when 'DE' then 'DE_LU' when 'IT' then 'IT_NORD' else split_part('$corridor','-',2) end as t),
r as (select (date + (substring("productIdentification" from 2 for 2)::int - 1) * interval '1 hour') as t, "auctionPrice" as p from jao.auction_results where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode"='$corridor' and "productIdentification" ~ '^B[0-9]{2}-'),
pf as (select time_bucket('1 hour', index) as h, avg(value) as v from entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices where $__timeFilter(index) and country=(select f from z) group by 1),
pt as (select time_bucket('1 hour', index) as h, avg(value) as v from entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices where $__timeFilter(index) and country=(select t from z) group by 1)
select $__timeGroupAlias(r.t,$__interval), avg(r.p) as "JAO auction price (EUR/MW)", avg(pt.v - pf.v) as "day-ahead spread to-from (EUR/MWh)"
from r left join pf on pf.h = r.t left join pt on pt.h = r.t group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Price of the daily explicit capacity auction against the day-ahead price spread of the two zones (ENTSO-E). Rational bidders pay roughly the expected spread TO minus FROM (positive spread = value of the capacity). The zones are derived from the corridor code (DE = DE_LU, IT = IT_NORD); borders to GB or Ukraine have no ENTSO-E prices.

panels.title: Offered, requested and allocated capacity: $corridor

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(t,$__interval), avg(o) as "offered", avg(rq) as "requested", avg(al) as "allocated"
from (select (date + (substring("productIdentification" from 2 for 2)::int - 1) * interval '1 hour') as t, "offeredCapacity" o, "requestedCapacity" rq, "allocatedCapacity" al from jao.auction_results where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode"='$corridor' and "productIdentification" ~ '^B[0-9]{2}-') x group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Capacity per hour in the daily auction: offered by the TSOs (= ATC), requested by market participants and allocated.

panels.title: Daily average auction price per corridor

targets.rawSql:
select date as time, "corridorCode" as metric, avg("auctionPrice") as "EUR/MW" from jao.auction_results
where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode" in ($corridors) and "productIdentification" ~ '^B[0-9]{2}-' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Daily mean of the hourly auction prices for the corridors chosen in the variable 'corridors to compare'.

panels.title: Mean auction price by corridor

targets.rawSql:
select "corridorCode" as corridor, avg("auctionPrice") as "EUR/MW" from jao.auction_results
where $__timeFilter(date) and "productIdentification" ~ '^B[0-9]{2}-' group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 25

panels.description: The 25 corridor directions with the highest mean daily-auction price in the range.

panels.title: Auction price by hour of day: $corridor

targets.rawSql:
select substring("productIdentification" from 2 for 2)::int as "hour", avg("auctionPrice") as "EUR/MW" from jao.auction_results
where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode"='$corridor' and "productIdentification" ~ '^B[0-9]{2}-' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Average price per delivery hour (B01 = 00:00-01:00 local time). Shows the daily scarcity pattern of the border.

panels.title: Competition: bidders per auction and oversubscription

targets.rawSql:
select date as time, avg("bidderPartyCount") as "bidders", avg("winnerPartyCount") as "winners", avg("requestedCapacity"/nullif("offeredCapacity",0)) as "requested / offered"
from jao.auction_results where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode"='$corridor' and "productIdentification" ~ '^B[0-9]{2}-' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Daily means of the number of bidding and winning parties and of the ratio of requested to offered capacity.

panels.title: Day-ahead prices of both zones and auction price

targets.rawSql:
with z as (select case split_part('$corridor','-',1) when 'DE' then 'DE_LU' when 'IT' then 'IT_NORD' else split_part('$corridor','-',1) end as f,
 case split_part('$corridor','-',2) when 'DE' then 'DE_LU' when 'IT' then 'IT_NORD' else split_part('$corridor','-',2) end as t)
select $__timeGroupAlias(index,$__interval), country as metric, avg(value) as "price" from entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices
where $__timeFilter(index) and country in ((select f from z),(select t from z)) group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select $__timeGroupAlias(t,$__interval), avg(p) as "JAO auction price $corridor" from (select (date + (substring("productIdentification" from 2 for 2)::int - 1) * interval '1 hour') as t, "auctionPrice" p from jao.auction_results
where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode"='$corridor' and "productIdentification" ~ '^B[0-9]{2}-') x group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: ENTSO-E day-ahead prices of the two zones of the selected corridor and the JAO auction price of that corridor (EUR/MWh vs EUR/MW).

panels.title: Long-term auctions (week, month, quarter, season, year)
Long-term auction prices: $corridor (last 3 years)

targets.rawSql:
select r.date as time, a.horizon || ' ' || r."productIdentification" as metric, avg(r."auctionPrice") as "EUR/MW"
from jao.auction_results r join jao.auctions a on a.id = r."auctionId" and a.date = r.date
where r.date > now() - interval '3 years' and r."corridorCode"='$corridor' and a.horizon in ('Weekly','Monthly','Quarterly','Seasonal','Yearly') and r."auctionPrice" is not null
group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Prices of the long-term products on the selected corridor (period start on the time axis), independent of the dashboard time range. Base and peak products. Empty if the corridor has no long-term auctions.

panels.title: Auctions per horizon

targets.rawSql:
select date_trunc('month', date) as time, horizon as metric, count(*) as "auctions" from jao.auctions
where $__timeFilter(date) group by 1,2 order by 1,2

panels.description: Number of auctions per product horizon by month of delivery start (all corridors). Most auctions are daily.

panels.title: Auctions per corridor and share cancelled

targets.rawSql:
select corridor, count(*) filter (where not cancelled) as "held", count(*) filter (where cancelled) as "cancelled" from jao.auctions
where $__timeFilter(date) and horizon = 'Daily' group by 1 order by count(*) desc limit 25

panels.description: Daily auctions per corridor in the range, stacked into held and cancelled auctions.

panels.title: Daily bids: bid price vs awarded price ($corridor)

targets.rawSql:
select date as time, avg(price) as "mean bid price", avg("awardedPrice") as "auction (clearing) price", max(price) as "highest bid"
from jao.bids_daily where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode"='$corridor' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Bids of the daily auction (table bids_daily): mean and highest submitted bid price against the resulting auction price. A large gap means bidders submit far above the clearing price.

panels.title: Daily bids: quantity bid vs awarded ($corridor)

targets.rawSql:
select date as time, sum(quantity) as "bid quantity", sum("awardedQuantity") as "awarded quantity", sum("resoldQuantity") as "resold quantity"
from jao.bids_daily where $__timeFilter(date) and "corridorCode"='$corridor' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Sum of bid quantities (MW over all hourly products of the day) versus awarded quantities. Awarded quantity is much smaller since most bids lose.

panels.title: Monthly bids by delivery length

targets.rawSql:
select (round("productMinutesDelivered"/60.0/24))::int || ' days' as delivered, count(*) as bids from jao.bids_monthly
where date > now() - interval '12 months' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Last 12 months (independent of time range): number of bids in monthly auctions grouped by the number of delivered days of the product (28-31 days, shorter at partial months).

panels.title: Resold capacity (range)

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum("resoldCapacity"),0) as v from jao.auction_results where $__timeFilter(date) and "resoldCapacity" > 0

panels.description: Sum of capacity re-sold by long-term holders (auction_results.resoldCapacity) in the range. Note: bids_*.resoldQuantity is zero in all rows of the data, so it is not used.

panels.title: Awarded price of long-term bids over time (all corridors)

targets.rawSql: select date as time, 'monthly' as metric, avg("awardedPrice") as "price" from jao.bids_monthly where date > now() - interval '3 years' group by 1 order by 1
select date as time, 'yearly' as metric, avg("awardedPrice") as "price" from jao.bids_yearly where date > now() - interval '3 years' group by 1 order by 1
select date as time, 'quarterly' as metric, avg("awardedPrice") as "price" from jao.bids_quarterly where date > now() - interval '3 years' group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: Average awarded price of bids per auction in the long-term bid tables over the last 3 years (independent of time range, all corridors mixed).
